```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 14)
```

```{r}
.libPaths(.Library)
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(anndataR)
library(bigstatsr)
# devtools::load_all("../../anglemania")
library(matrixStats)
library(yaml)
```

# Load config
```{r}
cfg <- read_yaml("/home/akollot/projects/CRC1588/dataset_integration/anglemania_benchmark/scripts/config_files/config_n_cells_test.yml")
```

# Load metrics
```{r}
# Extract relevant paths
metrics_path <- cfg$visualization$metrics_file
samplesheet_path <- cfg$samplesheet
outplot_bm <- cfg$visualization$outplot_dir_bm_visualization
# Ensure plot directories exist
if (!dir.exists(outplot_bm)) {
  dir.create(outplot_bm, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Load data
metrics <- read_tsv(metrics_path)
samplesheet <- read_tsv(samplesheet_path)

metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(samplesheet %>% select(-original_h5ad), by = join_by(sample == sample_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    groupCells = factor(groupCells),
    gene_selection = factor(gene_selection),
    integration_method = factor(integration_method)
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

View(metrics)
```



# Plot
## violin plots
### Total Score
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
for (m in unique(metrics$integration_method)) {
  p <- metrics %>%
    filter(integration_method == m) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(group_cells), y = total, fill = gene_selection)) +
    geom_bar(width = 0.5, position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("angl" = "#64487A", "hvg" = "grey")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Number of Cells", y = "Integration Score", title = paste0(m, "_TotalScore_violin")) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1)
    )

  print(p)
      # ggsave(
      #   file.path(outplot_bm, paste0(m, "_TotalScore_bar.pdf")),
      #   width = 10, 
      #   height = 10,
      #   plot = p
      #   ) 
    }
  

```

```{r}
metrics %>%
  distinct(ngroup, nbatch)
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- metrics %>%
  filter(integration_method == "scvi") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de_fac_loc), y = total)) +
  # geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge, width = 2)+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7)) +
  # make manual color
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +  # "Paired" is a good palette for qualitative factors
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("angl" = "#64487A", "hvg" = "grey"))+
  labs(x = "Biological Variability", y = "Integration Score") +
  # increase font size of all text
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.1)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ ngroup + nbatch, ncol = 5, labeller = "label_both")
p
```

### Bio.conservation
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
for (m in unique(metrics$integration_method)) {
  for (i in unique(metrics$ngroup)) {
    for (j in unique(metrics$nbatch)) {
      p <- metrics %>%
        filter(ngroup == i, nbatch == j, integration_method == m) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de_fac_loc), y = bio_conservation)) +
        # geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge, width = 2)+
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge) +
        geom_jitter(aes(fill = gene_selection), alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7)) +
        # make manual color
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("angl" = "#64487A", "hvg" = "grey"))+
        theme_bw() +
        labs(x = "Biological Variability", y = "Bio.conservation", title = paste0(m, "-ngroup", i, "-nbatch", j )) +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        # increase font size of all text
        theme(
          text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          aspect.ratio = 1,
          legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1)
        )
        print(p)
        # ggsave(
        #   file.path(outplot, paste0(m, "_ngroup", i, "_nbatch", j, "_BioConservation_violin.pdf")),
        #   width = 10,
        #   height = 10,
        #   plot = p
        # )
    }
  }
}
```

### Batch.correction
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
for (m in unique(metrics$integration_method)) {
  for (i in unique(metrics$ngroup)) {
    for (j in unique(metrics$nbatch)) {
      p <- metrics %>%
        filter(ngroup == i, nbatch == j, integration_method == m) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de_fac_loc), y = batch_correction)) +
        # geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge, width = 2)+
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge) +
        geom_jitter(aes(fill = gene_selection), alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7)) +
        # make manual color
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("angl" = "#64487A", "hvg" = "grey"))+
        theme_bw() +
        labs(x = "Biological Variability", y = "Batch.correction", title = paste0(m, "-ngroup", i, "-nbatch", j )) +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        # increase font size of all text
        theme(
          text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          aspect.ratio = 1,
          legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1)
        )
      print(p)
      # ggsave(

    }
  }
}
```
